ModulePrefs.title: Restricted Web Navigator Controller
ModulePrefs.description: Persistent Back and Home controls for a Revel Digital Web Page zone.
ModulePrefs.author: Custom Gadget

Module.Content:
<style>
html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: transparent;
}

#nav {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 8px;
}

button {
    flex: 1;
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: rgba(20,20,20,.88);
    color: #fff;
    font: 600 22px Arial, sans-serif;
}

button:active {
    background: rgba(70,70,70,.95);
}
<script type="text/javascript">

var prefs = new gadgets.Prefs();

function onLoad() {

    var back = document.getElementById("back");
    var home = document.getElementById("home");

    back.onclick = function() {

        back.innerHTML = "SENDING BACK";

        /*
         * Send a command to the Revel Digital player.
         */
        if (window.RevelDigital &&
            RevelDigital.Controller &&
            RevelDigital.Controller.sendCommand) {

            RevelDigital.Controller.sendCommand(
                "navigator.back",
                ""
            );

        } else {

            back.innerHTML = "NO CONTROLLER";

            window.setTimeout(function() {
                back.innerHTML = "Back";
            }, 1500);

            return;
        }

        window.setTimeout(function() {
            back.innerHTML = "Back";
        }, 1000);
    };


    home.onclick = function() {

        home.innerHTML = "SENDING HOME";

        var homeUrl = prefs.getString("homeUrl");

        if (window.RevelDigital &&
            RevelDigital.Controller &&
            RevelDigital.Controller.sendCommand) {

            RevelDigital.Controller.sendCommand(
                "navigator.home",
                homeUrl
            );

        } else {

            home.innerHTML = "NO CONTROLLER";

            window.setTimeout(function() {
                home.innerHTML = "Home";
            }, 1500);

            return;
        }

        window.setTimeout(function() {
            home.innerHTML = "Home";
        }, 1000);
    };

}

gadgets.util.registerOnLoadHandler(onLoad);

</script>
